label: For "Fake & Bulk Account Creation Detection": Stop automated and farmed account registrations at signup, protecting downstream trust, promos and abuse systems. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labels from accounts later banned (late and biased).
